shape: unit_sheet.json Phương tiện: UAV lớn cánh thẳng rất dài, mũi phình (radar), đuôi chữ Y, tên lửa dưới cánh; từ trên xuống: cánh dài gấp đôi thân; khoảng 4.4 x 8.0 x 1.5 m (0,4 x MQ-9 Reaper); vũ khí nhìn thấy AGM-114 Hellfire, GBU-39 SDB; vạch màu phe trên nóc và hai hông; không phù hiệu thật.
confidence: xấp xỉ (MQ-9 published photographs; flying, gear retracted)

features.feature: fuselage with the bulbous satcom nose, EO/IR turret under the chin
very long straight wing (twice the fuselage) with flaps and ailerons, lights
Y tail: two fins canted up, the ventral fin down
three-bladed pusher propeller, dorsal intake, ventral cooler scoop, exhaust stubs
outer stations with twin Hellfire rails, inner stations with GBU-39 racks
satcom and blade aerials, access panels

merged_note: the Reaper has no flare dispenser (the def has no flareCharges); its canopy role is the EO/IR window. Gate request: the jet roles' flares only when the def has flares.

weapons.note: main, 1 barrel; Muzzle_missile.001 on the other wing (kept)
aim Hull; Muzzle_rocket.001 on the other wing (kept)
